Hi Karen / Tom —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary goal: validate integration approach for ingestion pipeline and live inference routing; confirm latency targets for inference in-production (~150ms p95).
- Constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data flows for certain telemetry; need to confirm VPC/private deployment options for the pilot.

Suggested next step: a 60-minute technical deep-dive where our infra lead walks through the integration pattern, KV cache behavior, and runtime deployment options. I can bring the mutual action plan (attached) and Ben will cover cost/throughput tradeoffs.

Proposed windows (PST):
1) Tue Mar 14 — 8:30am–9:30am
2) Wed Mar 15 — 11:00am–12:00pm
3) Thu Mar 16 — 2:00pm–3:00pm

Please confirm which works best and who from your side will be on the call (engineering, security, procurement). Also let me know if you prefer Zoom (recording + breakout room) or Google Meet.

Attached: Medlytics-MAP-v2.pdf (updated mutual action plan)

Agenda (draft):
- 5m quick goal alignment
- 20m integration pattern & infra considerations (Marcus)
- 20m runtime/latency and batching discussion (Ben)
- 10m open Q&A & next steps

Thanks — happy to lock one of the windows as soon as you confirm attendees.

Soojin Lee
